profile_text.body:
Character.AI, founded in 2022, operates an AI chat platform where users interact with AI characters. The company describes itself as offering "AI Chat, Reimagined" and positions its service as "the #1 AI chat app" where users can "chat with millions of AI Characters."

The company's main product is Character.ai, a chat application built on large language models that enables persona-based conversations. The platform carries documented risks around appropriate use and human resources applications.
